name: Kotobuki Miyuki
source: A ditzy and energetic girl who's always at the wrong end of the luck side. But no matter how bad Lady Luck treats her, she's so resilient she'll come out with just tousled hair. She has a knack for making friends, and gives each of them a special and affectionate nickname; her best one is Miho Shirayuki.
